subject.title: [Feature Request] Session List: Show timestamp + last message preview

question: Should the narrow Control UI Sessions-list timestamp and preview land independently, or be folded into the broader sessions overview/session-title direction?
rationale: The backend and TUI already support last-message previews, but the visible Control UI list design overlaps with open session overview, sorting, and derived-title requests.

options.title: Land the narrow preview
options.body: Approve a focused Control UI change that requests includeLastMessage and renders a compact preview in the current Sessions table.

options.title: Fold into broader overview
options.body: Keep this issue linked to the broader sessions workspace design and make that canonical before closing narrow PR attempts.

options.title: Defer table previews
options.body: Keep the Sessions table as a technical management view until a maintainer states the UX rationale for not adding previews now.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow preview
recommendation.body: Approve a focused Control UI change that requests includeLastMessage and renders a compact preview in the current Sessions table.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate from recent Control UI Sessions page history and the original preview commit metadata.
